methodology: Cross-referenced GSC query/page data (gsc-analysis.json) with DataForSEO keyword volume/difficulty lookups (dfs_keyword_research, dfs_bulk_keyword_volume), then filtered out any keyword already targeted by an existing page — the 13 condition pillar pages, the ~35 migrated blog posts (lib/blog-posts.ts), or the 208 live-but-unmigrated legacy blog posts (_unmigrated-blog-slugs.json). Only keywords with confirmed real demand AND no existing content anywhere (migrated or not) were selected for Batch 1.
criticalFinding: The live production site (drautoimmune.com) has ~238 existing blog posts total; only ~35 have been migrated into this Next.js rebuild so far. The other 208 are live today and cover the large majority of high-volume informational keywords found in GSC (ANA patterns, leaky gut, ferritin/anemia, PCOS+B vitamins, dirty dozen, antihistamines, NAC, POTS, thyroid detox, etc.). This means the realistic net-new /learn page opportunity is much smaller than initially scoped, and migrating those 208 posts into this codebase is a separate, higher-priority workstream than new pSEO content (see final report).
